title: snownico0722/PaperTodo

why_good: PaperTodo is a minimalist Windows desktop sticky note tool that allows users to create independent notes and to-do lists directly on their desktop without any management interface. It supports Markdown for enhanced note-taking.
value: Individual users seeking a distraction-free note-taking experience pay for the ability to jot down thoughts and tasks instantly, without the overhead of traditional apps.
risk: Established productivity tools like Microsoft OneNote or Evernote dominate the market, posing a challenge for user adoption due to their extensive feature sets.

zh.claim: 体验 PaperTodo 的极简桌面便签，享受无杂乱工作空间——已有 1,282 个星标！
zh.why_good: PaperTodo 是一款极简的 Windows 桌面便签工具，允许用户在桌面上直接创建独立的便签和待办事项，而无需管理界面。它支持 Markdown，增强了记笔记的体验。
zh.value: 寻求无干扰记笔记体验的个人用户为能够即时记录想法和任务而付费，无需传统应用的复杂性。
zh.risk: 微软 OneNote 或 Evernote 等成熟的生产力工具主导市场，因其丰富的功能集，用户采用面临挑战。
zh.hook: 体验 PaperTodo 的极简桌面便签，享受无杂乱工作空间——已有 1,282 个星标！
zh.does: PaperTodo 是一款极简的 Windows 桌面便签工具，允许用户在桌面上直接创建独立的便签和待办事项，而无需管理界面。它支持 Markdown，增强了记笔记的体验。
zh.edge: 每张便签作为独立窗口操作，使用户能够快速访问和互动，而无需多余的点击或干扰。
zh.why_use: 选择 PaperTodo，因其简单性和对即时可用性的关注，与其他需要复杂设置和账号管理的记事应用不同。
zh.gap: 缺口不是「只有极客能用」，恰恰相反：它已经足够简单，而它自己的 issue 区里是一群双屏普通用户，抱怨没法把便签挪到另一块屏上。是主流笔记应用集体走去了另一边——账号、同步、工作区——把桌面本身空了出来。
zh.counter: 这是一个免费小工具，而这个品类三十年来是免费赢：Windows 自带便笺，没有人为一张便利贴付过钱。issue 区的诉求也是没有边界的打磨（分屏摆放、右键菜单、胶囊行为），小工具就是这样悄悄长成大软件、却始终没长成生意。
zh.differentiator: 不卖那张纸，卖纸后来去哪了。桌面便签三十年没做过的一件事是「记得」——三个月前写在一块你已经不用的显示器上的那张，就这么没了。同样安静的纸，加上「这台机器上我写过的所有东西，能搜，永不上传」。冷启动第一步：中文＝小红书「桌面便签 推荐」「电脑便签 不打扰」标签下的评论区；英文＝r/Windows 与 r/productivity 里求「不要账号的便签」的帖子。
zh.consumer_angle: 用的人是那种把便利贴粘在显示器边框上的 Windows 用户。他拿到的就是同一张便利贴，只不过在屏幕上——安静、一直在、不用注册、不同步、没有连续打卡、什么都不催他。它 issue 区里提需求的是双屏办公的普通人（想把便签拖到另一块屏上），不是开发者在提 feature request。

edge: Each note operates as an independent window, enabling quick access and interaction without unnecessary clicks or distractions.
why_use: Choose PaperTodo for its simplicity and focus on immediate usability, unlike other note-taking apps that require complex setups and account management.
hook: Experience a clutter-free workspace with PaperTodo's minimalist sticky notes—1,282 stars strong!

gap: The gap is not that only geeks can use it — the opposite. It is already simple, and its tracker is full of ordinary two-monitor users who cannot move a note to the other screen. Every mainstream note app walked the other way, into accounts, sync and workspaces, and left the desk itself empty.
counter: This is a free utility in a category where free has won for thirty years: Windows ships Sticky Notes, and nobody has ever paid for a sticky note. The tracker's request list is also unbounded polish — per-monitor placement, right-click menus, capsule behaviour — which is how a small tool quietly becomes a large one without ever becoming a business.
differentiator: Do not sell the note; sell what happens to it afterwards. The one thing desktop stickies have never done is remember — a note you scribbled three months ago on a monitor you no longer own is simply gone. Ship the same silent paper plus 'everything I ever scribbled on this machine, searchable, never uploaded'. Cold start (Chinese): 小红书「桌面便签 推荐」「电脑便签 不打扰」标签下的评论区; (English): r/Windows and r/productivity threads asking for a sticky-note app with no account.
consumer_angle: A Windows user who keeps a paper sticky note stuck to the monitor bezel. What they get is that same note on the screen — quiet, always visible, no account, no sync, no streak, nothing that nags. The tracker's own users are ordinary two-monitor office people asking to drag a note to the other screen, not developers filing feature requests.
